entries.heading: Of the unobligated balances provided pursuant to section
ancestors: DIVISION A—-AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2015
entries.text:
Sec. 709.  Of the unobligated balances provided pursuant to section 
12033 and section 15101 of the Food, Conservation, and Energy Act of 
2008, $125,000,000 are rescinded.

entries.heading: None of the funds made available pursuant to the
ancestors: DIVISION E—FINANCIAL SERVICES AND GENERAL GOVERNMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2015
entries.text:
Sec. 709.  None of the funds made available pursuant to the 
provisions of this or any other Act shall be used to implement, 
administer, or enforce any regulation which has been disapproved 
pursuant to a joint resolution duly adopted in accordance with the 
applicable law of the United States.
